category_title: EFL children with learning difficulties exhibiting behavioral disengagement and low motivation
minimal_context: The student is supposed to be participating in a post-story Q&A team game in the classroom.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our post-story Q&A game. Please sit with your team and look at the first question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Ignores the tutor and plays with a pencil) I don't care about the story. I hate English.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Try to focus on the game with your teammates.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Starts tearing strips of paper instead of looking at the questions) No.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put the paper down and answer the question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Gets up and starts running around the room, trying to fight with another student) I'm not doing this!
